summary: This is a recurring, ticketed guided mushroom-foraging tour run by a single host ("Doctor Delia"), sold as individual paid experiences ($18-$29, some free dates) on Eventbrite. Each listing repeats identical boilerplate about songs, chants, and a 'mushroom dance,' with no membership language, sign-up form, dues, named regulars, or links to a Facebook/Meetup/Discord group. It reads as a commercial, queer-themed nature tour rather than a persistent community with returning members.

evidence.note: All 7 listings across 2.5 months share nearly identical marketing copy ('Come on a Queer-Led adventure...') with no reference to members, regulars, or a group identity.
Prices range Free/$18/$29 and locations vary (Masters Park, Bent Creek trailhead), consistent with a paid tour series rather than a fixed club meeting spot.
Web search shows this is one of many similarly-named Eventbrite listings by the same host stretching back to at least 2025, i.e. a standing tour product, not a single community's recurring meetup.

Search results describe 'Doctor Delia's Medicinal Mushroom Tours' as queer-led, open-to-all guided tours in the Asheville area combining foraging education with singing/chanting/dance, framed as a tour offering rather than a club or support group.

Fetched the Eventbrite page directly: no membership, dues, or group-org language found; described as a ticketed 2.5-hour in-person experience with a standard refund policy, i.e. a commercial guided tour.
